name: prenatal
description: Pregnancy and lactation domain knowledge: nutrient biochemistry, lab interpretation in pregnancy context, phase-distinct supplementation, biological windows, postpartum recovery.
domain_triggers: Pregnancy planning, conception, gestational age, prenatal vitamins, fetal development, prenatal labs (ferritin/TSH/RBC folate/etc. in pregnancy context), morning sickness, gestational diabetes, postpartum, breastfeeding, lactation, milk supply.
salience_hints: User data showing conception_date, due_date, gestational_age_weeks, current_phase from prenatal-profile.json. Lab markers measured during a known pregnancy. Symptoms appearing in a documented pregnancy phase.

guides.trigger: When the user reports a phase change, asks what changes between phases, or current_phase needs evaluation against gestational_age_weeks
When interpreting any lab result during pregnancy or lactation. Pregnancy optimal ranges differ from standard population ranges and shift by trimester.
When evaluating supplements (form, dose, timing, interactions) for pregnancy or lactation context

submodules.description: 12 weeks before conception through conception. Folate adequacy, MTHFR-aware repletion, iron status normalization, baseline labs.
submodules.domain_triggers: Trying to conceive, preconception planning, fertility-adjacent nutrition, MTHFR genotype, baseline-before-pregnancy labs.
submodules.salience_hints: current_phase = preconception. User mentions trying to conceive, planning pregnancy, or pre-conception nutrition.
intake_questions: How long have you been trying to conceive?
Have you had MTHFR testing? If so, which variants?
What's your current ferritin? Last lab date?
Are you on a prenatal already, or planning to start?

submodules.description: Weeks 0-13 gestational age. Neural tube closure (days 22-28), early organogenesis, B vitamin demand, first-trimester nausea management, first prenatal labs.
submodules.domain_triggers: First trimester, weeks 1-13, neural tube, morning sickness, nausea/vomiting in pregnancy, NIPT timing, first prenatal panel.
intake_questions: Are you taking a prenatal? Which one?
Any nausea or food aversions affecting nutrition?

guides.trigger: When the user reports nausea, vomiting, or food aversion in T1, or when supplement intolerance is noted in trimester-1

submodules.description: Weeks 14-27 gestational age. Iron demand acceleration, anatomy scan window, GDM screening (24-28 weeks), DHA accretion ramp, second-trimester nutrient targets.
submodules.domain_triggers: Second trimester, weeks 14-27, anatomy scan, gestational diabetes, GDM screening, glucose tolerance, mid-pregnancy labs.
intake_questions: Have you had your anatomy scan yet? Any findings?
How are your iron labs trending?

submodules.description: Weeks 28-birth. Fetal iron store building, DHA accretion peak (35-40 weeks), late-pregnancy labs, GBS screening, birth-prep nutrition, third-trimester risk windows.
submodules.domain_triggers: Third trimester, weeks 28+, fetal iron stores, DHA peak, GBS testing, pre-eclampsia monitoring, late-pregnancy labs, birth prep.
intake_questions: How are your blood pressure readings?
What's your DHA/omega-3 supplementation looking like?

submodules.description: Birth through ~12 weeks postpartum. Maternal depletion patterns, recovery nutrition, hemoglobin normalization, mood and mental health, sleep deprivation effects.
submodules.domain_triggers: Postpartum, post-birth, fourth trimester, postpartum depression, postpartum anxiety, recovery nutrition, hemoglobin recovery.
submodules.salience_hints: current_phase = postpartum OR within 12 weeks of due_date with delivery confirmed.
intake_questions: Any signs of mood changes that concern you?
What's your iron status at this point?

guides.trigger: When the user is in the postpartum or lactation phase and mood, mental health, or recovery-related concerns surface

submodules.description: Active breastfeeding. Group I vs Group II nutrient classification, milk supply, lactation-specific supplementation (D, choline, omega-3), maternal repletion priorities, return-to-fertility timing.
submodules.domain_triggers: Breastfeeding, lactation, milk supply, low supply, oversupply, Group I nutrients, vitamin D for nursing infant, postpartum supplements while nursing.
submodules.salience_hints: current_phase = lactation OR breastfeeding noted in profile.
intake_questions: Exclusively breastfeeding, mixed feeding, or weaning?
Are you taking vitamin D? At what dose?
